question: What do the experts call the fiery form when the three abodes are established?
premises: Experts in scripture call that light-form fiery.
Here mere light remains present when the triad of abodes is established.
inference: The fiery designation names mere light as it abides through the threefold structure.
plain_english: Those skilled in scripture call that luminous form fiery. Here, when the three abodes are established, what remains is sheer light.
